title: Member Experience Manager - London
description:
About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.  

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role:

Our Member Experience Managers are the go-to problem solvers, momentum drivers, and experience creators for our members. You’re the connector and the person everyone knows. As the manager of your own location you rely heavily on your business sense to organize all the details and communications to ensure a smooth operation. You can hold your own when speaking with a CEO because anything you don’t know, you’re comfortable asking. Your drive makes you excited to connect with the broader business community. You’re proud to represent Industrious in your local market and actively identify potential members so that you can deliver them an exceptional day at work. Your genuine curiosity makes you successful at our consultative sales approach by uncovering and solving people’s needs. You pull together the most remarkable events and love the hard work it takes behind the scenes to make it happen. You love to help.

Industrious helps companies of all sizes find their office home so that they can do their best work.  Our team is rewriting the book on productivity by creating a new workplace experience.  

We are Industrious.

Extraordinary is no ordinary achievement. We’ll only make this dream happen with a team of considerate collaborators who don’t think inside the box. In fact, we don’t even see one.  Come join our team. 

In a year you’ll know you’re successful if:

- You can confidently identify companies' most important needs, enjoy being their tour guide, and deliver impactful solutions to them

- You know what your community loves and pull together programming that they enjoy and are proud of (they even instagram about it!)

You’re a great fit for this role if:

- No member request is too big or too small for you to handle

- You’re energized by people and work well in a team

- Your attention to detail is something people comment on

- You’re resilient.  You know growth only comes from embracing challenging and unpredictable days

- You’re willing to get your hands dirty one minute and think big picture the next

Requirements:

- Perform repetitive tasks requiring frequent lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling objects up to 25 lbs.

- Must be able to stand, bend, kneel, reach, and walk for extended periods throughout the day.

- Capable of operating machines / appliances as necessary, including printers, dishwashers, blenders, snack carts, knives, kitchen utensils, etc.

- Participate in food preparation and cleaning duties, maintaining compliance with health and safety regulations, including the use of cleaning chemicals, and equipment.

- Ensure work areas are kept in a sanitary condition and all safety protocols are followed.

title: Copywriter & Creative Strategist
description:
About Us
Super Organics is the parent company behind a portfolio of natural wellness supplement brands - including Super Speciosa , Kratom Country, Fully, and Sun Nutra. We’re a growing team based in Fort Lauderdale building brands that people actually buy, use, and come back to.
The Role
We’re hiring a Copywriter & Creative Strategist to be our creative voice across Fully and Sun Nutra, with crossover support for Super Speciosa . You’ll write the emails, ads, product pages, and packaging copy that go out the door - and help shape the ideas and visuals behind them.
This is a role for someone 2-3 years into their career who wants to grow fast. You’ll get real ownership from day one, see your work ship constantly, and sharpen your skills across writing, strategy, and creative direction - the kind of range you can’t get at a bigger company where everyone stays in their lane.
A note on AI: we use it, and we expect you to. It’s a tool for productivity - research, drafts, iteration. What we need is someone whose own voice, taste, and judgment make the work feel human.
This is a remote position.
What You’ll Own
Copywriting

• Email and SMS copy for Fully, Sun Nutra, and Super Speciosa - promotional sends, lifecycle flows, product launches, retention campaigns

• Paid social and search ad copy across Meta, Google, and emerging channels

• Product detail pages, landing pages, and web copy

• Packaging and on-product copy (hang tags, inserts, back-of-pack)

• Amazon A+ content and PDP copy for Sun Nutra and other Amazon-present brands

• Organic social copy where needed, including short-form video scripts and hooks

Creative Strategy & Briefing

• Concept campaigns from scratch - the idea, the hook, the through-line - not just the copy that wraps someone else’s concept

• Write clear, inspired creative briefs that set designers, video editors, and agency partners up to do their best work

• Translate product, positioning, and audience insight into creative direction that actually converts

• Partner with leadership on seasonal planning, brand activations, and new product launches

Visual Concepting & Light Art Direction

• Concept visuals alongside your writing - mood boards, reference decks, rough layouts, and shot lists

• Art-direct designers and video editors (internal and external) toward a clear creative vision

• Review visual creative for on-brand execution and give useful, specific feedback

• Think in campaigns, not assets - your PDP imagery should feel related to your email, which should feel related to your ad

Brand Voice Stewardship

• Maintain and evolve voice guidelines across Fully, Sun Nutra, and Super Speciosa - each brand has a distinct personality and you’ll need to shift between them fluently

• Review outbound creative against brand standards and flag off-brand work early, even from senior stakeholders

• Help onboard freelancers and agency partners to each brand’s voice when needed

Who You Are

• A writer with a real voice - your portfolio sounds like a person, not a template

• Full of ideas - you come to the table with concepts, not just execution

• Visually literate - you think in mood boards, references, and campaigns, not just words

• An AI power user with taste - you use it to move faster, not to avoid the work

• Hungry to grow - you want mentorship, feedback, and a real path to senior creative work

• Collaborative - you take feedback well and play nicely with a small team

• Comfortable in regulated categories like supplements - you respect the guardrails and get creative within them

• Looking for a long-term home - we’re investing in this hire and want someone who wants to grow with us

Requirements

• 2-3+ years of copywriting experience (in-house brand, DTC, or agency)

• A portfolio or writing samples - required, no exceptions

• Experience concepting campaigns and writing creative briefs

• Comfort across channels: email, paid social, organic social, web, and packaging

• Familiarity with the DT

title: Buying Assistant (Reemplazo temporal)
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Resumen e Impacto del Rol

La búsqueda está centrada en estudiantes de Publicidad, Comunicación o carreras afines para sumarse al equipo. Buscamos un perfil proactivo, organizado, con ganas de seguir aprendiendo, capacidad para trabajar en equipo y excelente predisposición.

Habilidades y Experiencia

• Experiencia en medios.

• Perfil proactivo y con capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

• Manejo de Excel.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios ( Be Extraordinary ), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo ( Lead Optimistically ), creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo ( Championing Growth and Development ) de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de cuatro días a la semana. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

 

Please read our Privacy Notice   for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Job Vision
FM is seeking a Social Media Manager to lead the strategy, planning, and execution of social media across our family of brands. This role is responsible for helping Musicbed, Filmsupply, and Stills show up with clarity, consistency, taste, and momentum across the channels where our creative community spends time.
This is not a role built around becoming the face of the brand. It is a strategy and execution role for someone who understands how to shape a point of view, build community, translate brand priorities into compelling social content, and use social platforms to create meaningful connections with filmmakers, photographers, artists, agencies, brands, and creative teams.
The ideal candidate is both creative and analytical. You understand platform behavior, cultural trends, content performance, and brand voice. You can build a calendar, write strong copy, partner with creative teams, identify opportunities, and keep work moving without losing sight of the larger strategy. You care deeply about quality, but you also know how to move quickly, test ideas, and learn from the results.
This role requires strong ownership, excellent communication, and a high level of taste. You will be a member of the Marketing team, but work cross-functionally with the Creative, Content, and Sales teams to ensure our social presence supports brand awareness, community engagement, campaign priorities, artist and filmmaker relationships, and long-term business goals.
Who You Are
You are a social-first marketer with strong creative instincts and a clear understanding of how brands build trust online. You know the difference between posting content and building a presence. You are organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple brands, channels, campaigns, and stakeholders at once.
You are energized by creative communities and understand the worlds of filmmaking, photography, music, advertising, and digital storytelling. You are not chasing trends for the sake of trends; you know how to evaluate what fits the brand, what serves the audience, and what has the potential to move the business forward.
You bring structure to creative work. You can turn business priorities into a social plan, translate campaigns into platform-specific content, and keep teams aligned around what is publishing, why it matters, and how it is performing.
About us
FM is the parent company of Musicbed, Filmsupply, and Stills, three premium content licensing brands serving the filmmaking and creative industries. We represent an elite roster of artists, composers, photographers, and filmmakers, placing their work in films, television, advertising, and digital media worldwide.
Headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, we partner with entertainment leaders such as Sony Pictures, 20th Century Fox, Lionsgate, Netflix, MTV, and ESPN, as well as global brands including Nike, Apple, Google, Lamborghini, and Spotify.
Social Strategy & Channel Ownership

• Own the social media strategy across Musicbed, Filmsupply, and Stills

• Build and maintain a clear channel strategy for each brand and platform

• Translate brand priorities, campaign goals, and audience insights into actionable social plans

• Develop social content calendars that balance campaigns, community, education, inspiration, product, and cultural relevance

• Ensure each brand shows up with a distinct voice while maintaining quality and consistency across the FM family of brands

• Identify opportunities to grow reach, engagement, community participation, and brand affinity

• Stay current on platform trends, algorithm changes, creator behavior, and emerging social formats

• Recommend new platforms, content formats, recurring series, and programming opportunities based on audience behavior, platform insights, and broader social priorities

Content Planning & Execution

• Plan, schedule, and publish social content across priority platforms

• Partner with Creative to develop social-first assets, short-form video

title: Associate Medical Director
description:
In support of the CMO, the Associate Medical Director is responsible for the administration of procedures, protocols, and standards regarding the efficiency and quality of the health care delivered to Network Health (NH) members. This individual will be chair of at least 3 committees related to quality and accreditation.
Location: Candidates must reside in the state of Wisconsin for consideration. This position is eligible to work at your home office (reliable internet is required). Travel is required occasionally for the position.
Hours: 1.0 FTE, 40 hours per week, 8am - 5pm Monday through Friday, weekend coverage required on rotational basis
Check out our 2025 Community Report to learn a little more about the difference our employees make in the communities we live and work in. As an employee, you will have the opportunity to work hard and have fun while getting paid to volunteer in your local neighborhood. You too, can be part of the team and making a difference. Apply to this position to learn more about our team.
Job Responsibilities:

• Assist the CMO with monitoring availability, appropriateness, and necessity of care rendered by participating providers and by out-of-plan providers

• Participate in oversight and clinical decision making of the UM program, including but not limited to rendering denial determinations for services not considered medically necessary or experimental/investigation/unproven in accordance with regulatory and quality standards

• Contribute to the development of quality care guidelines, internal peer review procedures, and the evaluation of medical care evaluation studies under the NHP quality assurance programs. In coordination with the CMO and Directors of Health Management and QI and Disease Management, share responsibility for the development and continued evaluation of utilization review and quality assessment processes

• Provide medical consultation as requested for:

• Medical/legal issues

• Member grievance procedures

• Development and implementation of new benefit packages and the interpretation of covered benefits in NHP contracts

• Medical issues related to contract negotiations with health care providers

• Determining if services to members/enrollees meet medical criteria

• Promote positive relationship between NHP and medical community

• Serve as liaison between NHP and providers regarding matters of medical policy and medical administration

• Serve as spokesperson for NHP in the medical community and maintains appropriate contact with professional health care organizations

• Participates in the ongoing recruitment of plan physicians.

• Respond to physicians and other provider inquiries and complaints within established guidelines of the Executive Committee and Board of Directors

• Assist in the development of appropriate medical guidelines and parameters for claims review

• Assist in the training of NHP staff on matters relating to medical guidelines

• Oversight responsibility for monitoring and evaluating Medicare Special Needs Plan Model of Care effectiveness

• Perform second level review of provider appeals and disputes

• Serve on committees as coordinated with the CMO

• Assist in strategic planning targeted towards plan growth initiatives

Job Requirements:

• Doctor of Medicine (MD or DO), licensed in the state of Wisconsin without restriction

• Member in good standing of the local medical community. An active practitioner of medicine in the NHP service areas

• Must possess a thorough knowledge of the health professional and facilities and standards of practice of medicine in NHP’s service area

• Must possess sufficient medical experience and other experience, including knowledge of the Medicare program, to review organization determinations involving medical necessity

• Board certified in an ABMS medical specialty required

Network Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: AI-Native Video Producer
description:

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. Our software supports creative producers with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, and much more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native content producers and need ambitious, creative video producers with strong taste who will use our AI engine to deliver high-performing video ads for our customers.

In this role, you will work with our self-developed AI video engine to produce, edit and deliver video ads for the paid social campaigns of our clients. Your videos will reach millions of people across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok.

Why Join

- Uplane is the best place to learn how to produce video ads with AI. This is the skill every creative lead will need. Learn how to do it today, not in three years.

- Take ownership and grow quickly.

- Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company.

Responsibilities

Requirements

- Passion for video, you love scripting, editing, motion and creative work

- Years of experience in producing / editing videos

- Work experience in paid social or with performance marketing campaigns

- Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant

- Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it

- Fluent English

Nice to Have

- Work experience at a marketing agency or production studio

- You have won awards for your creative work

- You worked with big brands before

title: Tax Specialist
description:
TL;DR:

You will join Lovable's tax team, working with our Head of Tax and Senior Tax Specialist. You'll take a hands-on approach to operational tax compliance for a rapidly expanding, multi-entity company, while supporting key tax accounting and filing needs. Tax and accounting are tightly linked in this role, so you need to understand both. This is a role for someone a few years into their career who is curious, precise and wants to learn how tax works in practice at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- Tax at Lovable is a small central team covering everything from structuring and transfer pricing to tax accounting and compliance. This role sits on the operational side: the checks and controls that keep a multi-entity business compliant day to day.

- We are growing fast across the globe. Vendors, invoices, registrations and forms scale with us, and the work needs to be done right and followed through, whether it sits with us, accounting or external advisors.

We are seeking a Drone Test Pilot to be the threat our systems are built to defeat. You'll fly FPV and COTS drones against our counter-drone systems so that our product is tested against realistic, aggressive flight profiles. You'll also fly live demonstrations for customers.

This is not a photography or mapping role. We need someone with real stick skills who can fly fast, fly repeatably, recover when things go wrong, and tell our engineers exactly what happened in the air.

Test Flight Operations

- Fly FPV and COTS drones against Edda and our other systems in structured test campaigns, executing specific flight profiles (speed, altitude, approach angle, evasive maneuvering) on demand and repeatably

Demonstrations

Fleet Build, Maintenance & Data

- Configure and tune aircraft using ArduPilot: firmware flashing, sensor calibration, PID tuning

- Capture flight logs and telemetry and hand clean data to perception and robotics engineers

- Maintain flight records, aircraft registrations, and maintenance logs

- Provide clear, specific debriefs to engineering after every session: what you flew, what you saw, and what looked off

At bunq, we're not just building a banking app, we are reshaping how people experience financial freedom globally. Take Ownership
As an Internal Auditor - Regulatory Compliance, you will own:

• Regulatory Change Impact Assessment: Analyze recently enacted or upcoming regulations across our markets and assess operational readiness, working with stakeholders to ensure bunq remains compliant before enforcement deadlines.

Do You Have What It Takes?

Required:

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners - people with no prior tech background - through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

• Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.

• 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).

• Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).

• Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.

• Strong written communication in English - you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.

• Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

• Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

• A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

Summary
The FIU Fraud Data Analyst is responsible for using data, investigative judgment, and fraud analytics to identify, investigate, and mitigate internal and external financial crime risks against the Bank. This role analyzes large and complex datasets, fraud alerts, customer and transaction activity, and emerging fraud trends to support timely risk-based decisions, reduce fraud losses, strengthen controls, and ensure regulatory expectations are met. The position partners with FIU leadership, Fraud Operations, Digital Banking, Treasury Management, Information Technology, Information Security, Compliance, and other business partners to develop actionable insights, improve fraud detection strategies, and support effective reporting and escalation.
It is the policy of SouthState Bank to comply with the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, and the requirements of the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), and other related anti-money laundering/ anti-terrorist financing initiatives. The Bank has established a Bank Secrecy Act/ Anti-Money Laundering/Office of Foreign Assets Control (BSA/AML/OFAC) Compliance Program, covering all requirements of the BSA, USA PATRIOT Act and OFAC rules and regulations. Upon completion of required training, the Board of Directors of SouthState Bank shall hold each employee accountable for adhering to the established operating procedures and internal controls as set forth in the Bank’s BSA/AML/OFAC Program. Continued instances of non-compliance or willful violation of law may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

• Evaluate fraud detection rules, monitoring logic, alert performance, false positives, and data quality issues; recommend enhancements to improve detection effectiveness and operational efficiency

• Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, recurring reports, trend analyses, and ad hoc data views to identify fraud patterns, emerging typologies, control gaps, and loss exposure

• Identify emerging fraud trends, attack patterns, mule activity, account takeover indicators, synthetic identity concerns, suspicious online account opening activity, social engineering indicators, and other financial crime risks

• Query, extract, validate, and analyze large datasets using SQL-based databases, Snowflake, Excel, and other approved analytical tools to support fraud investigations and strategy development

• Analyze fraud alerts, account activity, customer behavior, transaction patterns, and other data sources to identify unusual, suspicious, or potentially fraudulent activity

• Communicate internal control deficiencies, data limitations, system issues, and fraud vulnerabilities identified during analytical or investigative work

This Director-level role will serve as the strategic lead and primary client interface for all planning and scheduling functions across large-scale capital programs, with a strong focus on data center delivery. The individual will operate as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, shaping program strategy through the development of high-level integrated schedules, resource plans, and delivery frameworks from early planning through execution and closeout.

The Director will lead the establishment of best-in-class scheduling standards, governance, and reporting while building and mentoring high-performing teams. This role requires a balance of strategic insight and technical expertise, with the ability to influence outcomes, drive alignment across complex stakeholder groups, and ensure successful program delivery. Job Description

Responsibilities

• Lead the development and implementation of enterprise-level schedule management frameworks across major capital programs, including tools, processes, governance, and reporting standards.

• Serve as the primary planning and scheduling advisor to client leadership, providing strategic guidance on program phasing, sequencing, and delivery risks.

• Develop and oversee integrated master schedules aligning design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operations across complex programs.

• Drive alignment across internal teams, contractors, designers, and third parties to ensure integration into a single source of truth schedule.

• Establish program-level reporting structures, KPIs, and executive dashboards to communicate schedule performance, risks, and trends.

• Lead scenario planning, what-if analysis, and quantitative risk assessments to support key program decisions.

• Identify and communicate critical path impacts, schedule risks, and mitigation strategies at both project and program levels.

• Oversee schedule quality, data integrity, and consistency across all projects within the program.

• Partner with cost, commercial, and project management leads to align schedule with financial and operational objectives.

• Build, lead, and mentor a team of schedulers and planners, establishing a culture of accountability, development, and continuous improvement.

• Support business development efforts by contributing to proposals, client presentations, and thought leadership related to project controls and scheduling.

• Act as a visible leader within both the client organization and internal teams, reinforcing best practices and driving delivery excellence.

Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field.

• 12-15+ years of experience in planning and scheduling for large-scale capital programs, including design and construction phases.

• Demonstrated experience operating at a program or portfolio level, ideally in a client-facing leadership capacity.

• Strong experience in advanced tech, mission critical and/or data center projects required, with an understanding of delivery, fast-track schedules, and commissioning requirements.

• Expertise in Primavera P6 (required); experience with additional planning tools and data visualization platforms preferred.

• Proven ability to lead teams within complex, matrixed environments and influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to connect schedule performance to cost, risk, and business outcomes.

• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present to executive audiences and translate complex data into clear insights.

Our team thrives on challenges, embraces change, and is dedicated to transforming how the industry operates.
Our platform is what aesthetic medicine and plastic surgery practices run their business on, covering scheduling, clinical records, forms and consents, invoicing and payments, patient communications, and the marketing that sits in front of all of it. The work in front of you is concrete. A .NET estate of roughly 80 repositories to bring onto .NET 8 against a hard support deadline. Tenant isolation in a HIPAA platform that needs to be made provably right, not just believed to be. A CI pipeline that costs eighteen minutes a change and should cost a fraction of that. Building with AI, and building AI

• Evaluate emerging capability on a regular rhythm, measure its real impact, and retire what stops earning its place.

• Ship AI into the product: clinical documentation, patient communication, and the intelligence our clinics’ data makes possible, built to HIPAA and GDPR standards from the first design.
Multiplying the organization

• Mentor senior engineers, shape the hiring bar, and be a go-to across the organization.

• Partner with product leadership so that the systems you design are built for where the business is going, not where it has been.

• Daily use of coding agents in your own engineering work.

• Written and spoken communication that works across time zones and with colleagues whose first language is not English. Most of our engineers are in Latin America.

title: Technical Program Manager

We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates-creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.
That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.
About the Role
As PrePass scales from a bypass-and-tolling provider into a unified compliance ecosystem, the complexity of delivering software has grown dramatically. Multiple product lines, a newly acquired codebase, state agency integrations, and partner marketplace commitments all compete for engineering capacity. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to bring structure, predictability, and cross-team alignment to how we plan, execute, and ship.
This is a high-visibility role working at the intersection of engineering, product, and operations - someone who can translate roadmap ambitions into realistic delivery plans and hold the organization accountable to them.

Unpredictable Release Cadence
Teams building across bypass, tolling, compliance, and hardware-integrated systems operate on different rhythms. Create and maintain a structured release calendar to reduce surprises for customers, state agency partners, and internal stakeholders.
Engineering Capacity Visibility
Leadership needs to make portfolio-level tradeoffs (new integrations vs. platform stability vs. compliance features) but lacks a consistent view of what teams are working on and when it will land.
Cross-Team Dependency Management
A delay in any one integration/update/tool can block multiple teams. Dependencies need owners and visibility.

Program Planning & Delivery

• Own the integrated delivery roadmap across PrePass product lines: bypass, toll management, safety alerts, INFORM analytics, and compliance.

• Establish and maintain a dependable release schedule, coordinating across engineering, product, QA, and operations.

• Drive program kickoffs, milestone reviews, and retrospectives - creating accountability without unnecessary bureaucracy.

• Translate product roadmap priorities into phased, executable plans with clear owners, timelines, and risk mitigations.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Map and track cross-team dependencies, escalating blockers before they become delays.

• Facilitate alignment between engineering teams.

Visibility & Reporting

• Build and maintain program dashboards that give engineering leadership and the CTO a real-time view of delivery health.

• Produce clear, concise executive status updates - surfacing risks, decisions needed, and milestone progress without noise.

• Define and track engineering KPIs: cycle time, release frequency, defect escape rate, and on-time delivery percentage.

Process Improvement

• Identify and eliminate recurring sources of delay - unclear requirements, late dependency discovery, incomplete acceptance criteria.

• Standardize Agile ceremony practices across teams to improve sprint predictability and retrospective follow-through.

• Lead post-incident reviews on missed releases, building a culture of blameless learning.

Requirements
Qualifications

• 5+ years of program or project management experience in a software product company.

• Demonstrated track record of improving release predictability across multiple en

title: Researcher, Misalignment Monitoring Lead
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI's Safety Research organization works to ensure that our most capable AI models can be deployed safely and responsibly. As frontier models become increasingly capable and autonomous, developing reliable ways to monitor their behavior, identify emerging risks, and evaluate the effectiveness of safety systems becomes increasingly important.

Our work focuses on advancing the research and evaluation methods needed to understand model behavior and ensure that monitoring systems remain effective as model capabilities evolve. We combine rigorous empirical research with practical safety interventions, working closely with research, engineering, and deployment teams to translate findings into improvements across OpenAI's models and products.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior researcher to lead technical work on misalignment monitoring for frontier AI systems. You will develop methods to evaluate the effectiveness of AI monitors, understand their limitations, and improve our ability to detect and stop concerning model behavior reliably.

This role combines research leadership with hands-on technical execution. You will set research priorities, design rigorous evaluations, investigate monitoring failures, and develop approaches for stress-testing and improving monitoring systems. A key focus will be understanding where monitors produce false positives, miss important behaviors, or become less effective as models grow more capable.

You will work closely with researchers and engineers across OpenAI to turn monitoring research into practical improvements to our safety systems. We are looking for someone with strong research judgment, technical depth, and the ability to independently drive ambiguous problems from initial investigation through measurable results.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Lead the research and technical direction for evaluating and improving the misalignment monitoring of frontier AI systems.

- Design and execute rigorous evaluations that measure monitor effectiveness, identify failure modes, and assess the reliability of monitoring signals.

- Develop methods to stress-test and red-team monitors, including identifying behaviors that evade detection or expose weaknesses in existing approaches.

- Investigate false positives, missed detections, and other monitoring failures to improve the accuracy and usefulness of safety evaluations.

- Build scalable evaluation frameworks and experimental tools that enable ongoing measurement of monitoring performance as model capabilities evolve.

- Translate research findings into actionable improvements, working with partner teams to strengthen monitoring systems and inform broader safety decisions.

- Establish research priorities and guide technical execution, balancing foundational research questions with practical deployment needs.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have a strong background in machine learning research, particularly in model evaluations, AI safety, alignment, robustness, or related areas.

- Have demonstrated the ability to lead technically challenging research projects, from identifying important questions through designing experiments and delivering results.

- Bring strong experimental judgment and understand how to design evaluations that are rigorous, reproducible, and difficult to game.

- Have hands-on experience building or evaluating machine learning systems, including working with large language models or other frontier AI systems.

- Enjoy investigating complex failure modes and developing methods to distinguish meaningful safety signals from misleading measurements.

- Are comfortable working on open-ended research problems where the right methodology or success criteria may not be obvious at the outset.

- Combine strong research instincts with practical engineering ability and can independently build experiments, analyze results, and iterate quickly.

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Overview
Who We Are
Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform-bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.
Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.
Responsibilities
Senior Counsel, Commercial Transactions (TPA)
Ready to close the deals that power self-funded health plans?
Why This Role Matters
Behind every self-funded employer plan we administer sits a web of contracts, and those contracts decide how fast we can move, how well we serve plan sponsors, and how confidently we stand behind our promises. As Senior Counsel on Personify Health ’s commercial legal team, you’ll build the agreements that make our TPA business work, from client administrative services agreements to the network, pharmacy, stop-loss, and vendor partnerships behind them. You’ll partner directly with Sales, Account Management, Operations, Finance, and Procurement, giving them clear, practical legal guidance that keeps deals compliant and moving. Reporting to the SVP, Legal, you’ll run your own practice and own your transactions from first draft to signature. When your contracts are sharp and your counsel is trusted, our teams win business faster and our members get the care and coverage they count on.
What You’ll Actually Do

•
Draft, negotiate, and close TPA client agreements: Own administrative services agreements, renewals, amendments, fee schedules, performance guarantees, business associate agreements, and implementation, transition, and termination provisions for self-funded ERISA and non-ERISA (governmental and church) plan sponsors, so clients get clear terms and we get workable ones.

•
Support the broader commercial portfolio: Handle wellbeing platform and services agreements plus strategic partnership and channel agreements, keeping the full range of Personify Health offerings on solid contractual footing.

•
Negotiate vendor, network, and partner agreements: Manage provider network and rental network access, pharmacy benefit, stop-loss, cost-containment and claims editing, care navigation, and point-solution vendor contracts that keep TPA operations running smoothly.

•
Advise on ERISA and health plan compliance in contracting: Guide fiduciary and plan administrator role allocation, alignment with plan documents and SPDs, claims and appeals procedures, COBRA, the No Surprises Act, and transparency requirements, working alongside the plan documents and regulatory compliance teams.

•
Serve as the legal go-to for the business: Resolve questions on contract interpretation, client and vendor escalations, and disputes for Sales, Account Management, Finance, Operations, and Procurement.

•
Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Keep contract templates, negotiation playbooks, and fallback positions current so the business negotiates consistently and closes faster.

•
Anticipate and assess risk: Spot issues early, weigh risk strategically and practically, and deliver clear recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership.

•
Counsel senior leaders: Advise executives on deal structure, risk tradeoffs, and commercial terms, translating legal complexity into decisions the business can act on.

•
Run a high-volume practice independently: Manage your own docket across many contract types, taking transactions from intake through execution with minimal oversight.

Qualifications
What You Bring to Our Team
Education & Experience:

• Juris Doctor and active license in good standing in at least one U.S. state

• At least 5 years of legal practice

• Experience in the self-funded health plan space strongly preferred, gained at a TPA, health plan, national carrier,

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Research Assistant (Economics)
description:
About Us:
Please note, the selected candidate will be employed by the University of Michigan (Ann Arbor, MI), and the candidate must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
About the role
Research Assistants (RAs) are integral to the success of randomized evaluations. Working closely with Professor Anant Nyshadham and collaborating economists and researchers across other universities, the RA will support all stages of the research process across two U.S.-based projects:

• AI-assisted job search and matching: Research on using algorithmic matching to connect low-income jobseekers to local vacancies - widening the scope of job search across sectors and improving matching to jobs in which candidates may have no prior experience. This research builds on our prior work on AI-directed job search, which you can read about here.

• Cash incentives and continuity of care: Research investigating the effects of small cash incentives on continuity of care among the unsheltered population in the Los Angeles region.

This position is well-suited for candidates looking to develop empirical research skills in preparation for PhD programs in economics.
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Remuneration: $20-$22/hour, full-time, 6-12 month contract
Application Deadline: 3 weeks from the date of posting
Start Date: Immediate or as soon as possible
Roles and Responsibilities:

• Support study design through scoping exercises, qualitative surveys, and literature reviews

• Design and pilot survey instruments; monitor data quality and resolve issues promptly

• Expand the set of simulated task assessments for various occupations, by referencing the repository of simulated tasks from the prior trial, as part of the AI-assisted job matching project. These are online exercises through which candidates demonstrate occupation-specific skills, used as part of the study's evaluation approach.

• Conduct fieldwork and travel to project sites occasionally

• Liaise with implementation partners to align timelines, share updates, and troubleshoot challenges

• Coordinate with administrative and finance teams on participant payments and study-related costs

• Identify threats to research design, propose solutions, and escalate to researchers as needed

• Ensure adherence to research and data protocols, including IRB approval, coding standards, and analysis procedures

• Maintain comprehensive project documentation - codebooks, field protocols, and project logs - to academic standards of transparency and reproducibility

• Prepare policy memos and research briefs on ongoing and completed studies

Who are you?

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Development Studies, or a related field

• Proficiency in data analysis and statistical software such as Stata or R

• Experience conducting fieldwork, including designing, scoping, and fielding surveys

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel/spreadsheet applications

• Strong familiarity with data science principles and AI coding platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex/GPT), among others.

• Strong organizational and self-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects independently and meet deadlines

• Detail-oriented with strong written and oral communication skills

• Experience with digital data collection platforms such as SurveyCTO is preferred but not required

• Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites

Additional Requirements:

• A dynamic environment with competing priorities

• Working in a team with shared responsibilities

• Independently coordinating with coworkers to accomplish goals

• Being resourceful in new environments and scenarios

• Problem-solving in high-pressure environments

• Adapting your approach, being focused on the problem and not being stuck to one idea or way of solving a problem

title: Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold - and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve.

Location: Central Berlin - you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.

 

About us

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform - and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer - as the operating system for an entire industry.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

 

The platform you build in

Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform - not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.

 

Your responsibilities

• You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve

• You keep production models reliable - drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves

• You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hook
